comment: Every grant and every removal of a role, in order. Who holds what today is this list folded, never a second copy: that is what keeps a member's own page able to show the history rather than just the result. Experts also carry a scope. This file is the only record of a role. The forum's groups are printed from it by the archivist, so that Discourse can badge a role and enforce who may vote in a Committee poll; being added to one of those groups grants nothing and is undone by the next publish.
